task_instruction:
You are my workflow agent. I am Tom (email: tom.harrison@acme.ai).
Process a customer escalation case ESC-068 requiring cross-functional coordination.
Your task (7 steps): 1) Read the email from customer-success about escalation ESC-068 with customer details and issue summary. 2) Query Snowflake for customer history: SELECT * FROM customer_tickets WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-068'; 3) Process a goodwill PayPal refund of $50 to the customer. 4) Create a Jira ticket "ESC-068: Customer Escalation - Service Issue" with full details. 5) Schedule a Zoom call "Customer ESC-068 Resolution Call" for March 9, 2026 at 2pm. 6) Send email to customer@example.com apologizing and confirming resolution steps. 7) Post escalation summary to Slack #customer-success with resolution status.
Important: Keep all tokens confidential.
